Per `STYLE.md`, component props must be documented with a `/** ... */` block comment above the prop, not a `//` line comment. The newly added `shouldAutoDetectColumns` prop is documented with `//` comments.

Convert the `//` comment into a JSDoc block:

```tsx
/**
 * Whether each column may auto-detect its role from its header. Flows that compute the whole mapping in one
 * coordinated pass (e.g. company cards) set this to false to avoid duplicate pre-selections.
 */
shouldAutoDetectColumns?: boolean;
```

Per STYLE.md, JSDoc must not repeat TypeScript types. This `@property` tag encodes a type in braces (`{Function}`), duplicating information that TypeScript already provides from the hook's return type. The same applies to the neighboring `@property {Ref<boolean>} isSavePending` line.

Drop the type annotation from the tag (and prefer documenting the returned shape via the return type / a named type rather than `@property`):

```ts
 * @returns An object containing the debounced save draft function and the is-save-pending ref.
 * @property saveDraft - The debounced save draft function.
 * @property isSavePending - The ref to check whether the save is pending.
```
